title: Zahi Hawass pumps out the Osiris shaft and opens the container

tellings.quote: time? Oh, I don't know, but so this was done by Zahi Hawass and team. They pumped all the water out so that they could lift the lid off of the container on the third level.

plain: The Egyptian archaeologist Zahi Hawass and his team pumped all the water out of the Osiris shaft, a deep shaft with several levels under the Giza plateau, so they could lift the lid off a stone container on the third level. The researcher Jeffrey Drum tells Michels this, relaying it as Hawass's own work, and says he does not know when it happened. He raises it in a discussion of what he believes lies beneath the pyramids.
